m1.typescript: m1 a hub sends one brief to each spoke and synthesizes what comes back

e1.typescript: e1 a question the coordinator can answer itself is answered without any subagent

e2.typescript: e2 a subagent sees its own brief and nothing the others found

e3.typescript: e3 the plan is cleaned of empty briefs and duplicate scopes and capped

e4.typescript: e4 a failing subagent does not stop the others and a run with no findings does not synthesize

e5.typescript: e5 a review sends only the gaps back out and stops when none are left

e6.typescript: e6 the rounds are capped and the gaps that remain are reported

wrong-leaks-context.defect: appends what earlier subagents found to the brief of the next one

wrong-no-dedupe.defect: runs two subagents on the same scope

wrong-empty-brief-sent.defect: sends a subagent an empty brief

wrong-always-delegates.defect: builds a team even when the planner answered the question itself

wrong-failure-as-finding.defect: reports a subagent's error message as a finding

wrong-synthesizes-nothing.defect: synthesizes an answer when no subagent returned anything

wrong-rerun-all.defect: sends every first-round brief out again in each refinement round

wrong-rounds-off-by-one.defect: runs one refinement round more than the limit
